messages:
deploy-bot: Initiating canary rollout of model redwood-llm:v2.1 to 5% of traffic at 2024-11-15T02:00Z (commit abc123).
Priya: noticed tokenization warnings in canary logs, small % of requests returning "<unk>" tokens and malformed whitespace. Throwing tokenizer-encode errors intermittently.
Priya: log snippet:
```
2024-11-15T02:03:12Z ERROR tokenizer encode failed: Unknown token sequence at pos 23
request_id=ry7k
model=redwood-llm:v2.1
```
Jon: pulling canary pods, checking weight sets and tokenizer config. My hunch: label mismatch on weight bundle -> wrong tokenizer mapping.
Maya: @Jon you're on-call, paging you. incident-bot: Paging Maya (on-call) and Jon.
incident-bot: Pager triggered: severity=page, reason="canary tokenization errors", service=runtime-canary
Maya: on it, joining.
Ezra: CS reports one small customer (acme-inc) saw gibberish in chat UI, logged ticket. No PII exposed.
Maya: quick impact check — how many requests affected? Priya?
Priya: ~0.6% of canary requests show encode failures, error rate spike from 0.01% -> 0.6% since rollout.
Nate: putting observability dashboard snapshot: latency stable, but error rate + token anomalies visible in histogram.
Jon: found manifest bug — model variant label "v2_1" was mapped to weightset "v2.0-default" in manifest due to label normalization script. That mismatch causes tokenizer-vocab mismatch.
Priya: confirms weights don't align with tokenizer vocab header. This explains unknown tokens.
Maya: impact = customer-visible gibberish for subset of canary users. Recommend kill-switch now.
Jon: propose flip feature flag to stop routing to v2.1 and route to v2.0 until we fix manifest.
Claire: prep a short CS-safe blurb if we rollback: "We detected an encoding mismatch during a limited canary rollout and reverted to stable model. No customer data was exposed." OK?
Maya: roll kill switch command (ops):
```
# set rollout feature flag
opsctl featureflag set runtime.model.rollout v2.1 false --env=prod
# verify routing
opsctl routing show model=redwood-llm
```
deploy-bot: Feature flag flip executed by Maya at 2024-11-15T02:10Z. Routing rollback to redwood-llm:v2.0 confirmed.
Priya: KV/cache invalidation queued: `cachectl purge --model redwood-llm:v2.1 --scope=canary`
Jon: verification: canary pods now serving v2.0, tokenizer warnings gone in logs after one minute.
Priya: post-rollback checks:
- encoding errors -> 0.00%
- token distribution back to baseline
- no increase in 5xx
Nate: tracing shows customer requests that saw gibberish peaked ~02:05Z, extinguished by 02:11Z. Impact window ~6 minutes. Logged incident for SLA review.
Ezra: CS: contacting acme-inc with the prepared blurb, offering investigation notes. No escalations yet.
Maya: assigning follow-up tasks: Jon to fix manifest label normalization, Priya to add unit tests for tokenizer-weight mapping, Claire to draft incident summary for status page.
Maya: handing off to daytime oncall Jon for follow-up. Handoff note: all mitigations in place, canary paused, rollback complete. last_message_ts=1748888950
Jon: acknowledging handoff, will pick up tomorrow morning PT. Adding TODOs to the release PR.
Claire: thanks team :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident logged #INC-2024-321; priority=high; mitigation=rollback; owner=Maya
